channelTest.subject: Candela alert channel test ({{channel}})

reset.subject: [Candela] Password reset
reset.body:
Hello,

Use the link below to reset your password (valid for {{minutes}} minutes, single use):
{{link}}

If you did not request this, ignore this email.

Candela Analytics

setup.subject: [Candela] Set up your account password
setup.body:
Hello,

An administrator created a Candela Analytics account for you. Set your password via this link (valid for {{hours}} hours, single use):
{{link}}

You can sign in right after.

Candela Analytics

invite.subject: [Candela] Invitation to project {{project}}
invite.body:
Hello,

{{inviter}} invited you to the Candela Analytics project {{project}} as {{role}}.

Follow this link to sign up and join (valid for {{days}} days):
{{link}}

If you were not expecting this, ignore this email.

Candela Analytics

inviteNotify.subject: [Candela] You were added to project {{project}}
inviteNotify.body:
Hello,

{{inviter}} added you to the Candela Analytics project {{project}} as {{role}}.

Sign in with your existing account to access it.

Candela Analytics

test.subject: [Candela] Email channel test
test.body:
This is a test email from Candela Analytics.

Receiving it means the account SMTP settings are active: password reset, account setup and project invitation emails are ready.

Candela Analytics
